metadata.tagScope: All loaded item/block/fluid tags, including empty tags
metadata.nameSource: Installed mod assets language JSON, overridden by config/scex-tag-exporter/lang/<locale>.json; requested locale, then en_us, then runtime name/key. Client resource-pack overrides are not applied.
metadata.oreRule: item/block tags with path ores, ores/* or *_ores; never guessed from entry ID. Not world generation/distribution.
